'''Chief of Staff''' was a title held by individuals within various branches of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]. [[Cha Niathal]] was Chief of Staff after the [[Solo-Niathal coup|Chief of State coup]]. After the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], the title was held by [[Wynn Dorvan]], [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]]'s right-hand man. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]] served as Chief of Staff for the [[Galactic Alliance Army]].

Military organizations also used the title, evidenced by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles's]] time as Chief of Staff of the [[New Republic Starfighter Command/Legends|New Republic Starfighter Command]].

Wynn Dorvan's official title was Chief of Staff of the Galactic Alliance and it was said that he would become interim Chief of State should the sitting Chief die.
